title: loaded CG (+ 15 in, 30 kg meat check; CORRIE F rev 3: port guys, crown strap cinch, lid)
gates: rev 3 items: port guys at the S kit, crown strap cinch and free length, lid mass and seat
steps: 68 kg fill and meat on IM1-IM3 at 15/19/23 in; hang from haul loop, then from a hip pin, plumb both lines; add 30 kg on IM1-IM3 at 15 in; REV 3 (BL-030): (a) S kit (15 in), top full, port guys fitted, lid on with 1 kg, meat 30 kg on IM1-IM3 + fill to 68 kg: plumb-line CG both lines, record against 181.3 mm; (b) crown strap cinch: spring scale (0-150 N) on each strap's tail, pull to 80 N, lock; read again after 30 min of walking and after a 3 g drop-on-the-base (pack set down from 0.5 m); (c) cinched crown strap free length bar-tab to ladder lock at the S kit full and the L kit 6-day; (d) weigh the sewn lid alone (0.1 g scale) and photograph it on the packed 6-day and full bag from the rear 3/4 and the side
pass: bag CG <= 205 mm at z <= 590; meat <= 190; tall <= 185; rev 3: CG <= 190 mm (record vs 181.3); cinch after the walk >= 40 N or the lid still seated on the full top (report the value); free length <= cut - 210 mm (1138 - 150 tail - 60 loop = 928 mm); lid 45.9 g +/- 5 g (record); lid edge on the hinge-band seam, caps over the blades
